senses.gloss: m. (preced.) field-laborer, peasant; trnsf. boor, ignorant man.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 79a:1">Keth. 79ᵃ</cite> <he>חזי מר נחמן ח׳</he> see, sir, how this ignoramus Naḥman &c.—Pl. <he>חַקְלָאֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 12a:8">Sabb. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>אבל דח׳ וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>דבני חַקְלָיָתָא</he>) but the garments of the peasantry are easily distinguishable (as to men’s or women’s).
